title: The Man Who Cracked One Hand's Knuckles for 60 Years to Prove a Point
description:
You've probably been told cracking your knuckles causes arthritis. One doctor spent 60 years testing that on himself, one hand at a time.

Educational content, not medical advice.

#shorts #wellbeing #mythbusting

scenes.text: One doctor cracked the knuckles on his left hand every single day for over sixty years, leaving his right hand alone as the control.
It started as a teenager, to settle his mother's warning that knuckle-cracking causes arthritis.
At the end, neither hand showed any signs of arthritis, and there was no meaningful difference between them.
His results were published, and in 2009 he won an Ig Nobel Prize -- a real award for science that makes people laugh, then think.
Larger studies since then generally back this up. That cracking sound is just gas bubbles collapsing in the joint fluid, not damage.
Do you crack your knuckles -- and did anyone ever warn you it was bad for you?
